environment: .NET SDK 8.0.402, compiler pinned with Microsoft.Net.Compilers.Toolset 4.12.0, isolated worktrees, run 2026-11-15

runs.by: E2E sandbox: consumer project with [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] types that break the contract, built and run on base and branch (3 runs per side)
runs.what: Does the analyzer still report its diagnostics on SuppressSourceGeneration = true types?
runs.detail: Base (3/3 identical): MsgPack004, MsgPack005 x4 and MsgPack003 are reported, but the analyzer crashes twice (AD0001: ArgumentException 'An item with the same key has already been added' on duplicate keys, InvalidOperationException 'Nullable object must have a value' on mixed keys) and the generator crashes (CS8785); as a result MsgPack004 is missing on the unkeyed member that follows a duplicate key and a mixed key (DuplicateThenMissingKey.C, MixedThenMissingKey.C). Branch (3/3 identical): 8 diagnostics, including those two MsgPack004, no AD0001, no CS8785. Note: plain cases (missing key alone, non-serializable member type) are already reported on base; the 'analyzer does not work at all' symptom from the issue was not reproduced on base 32258fdb.

runs.by: E2E sandbox: consumer project with a valid suppressed type and a normal control type, EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles on, built and run on base and branch (3 runs per side)
runs.what: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, is no formatter generated, while a normal type still gets one?
runs.detail: Identical on base and branch (3/3 each): generated resolver present, no generated formatter for Suppressed (GetFormatter returns null, 0 generated types and 0 generated source files mention it), control type Control has a generated formatter (2 generated files), Suppressed round-trips through the dynamic resolver. AC-2 already held on base: this is a non-regression proof, not a fail-before.

runs.by: Isolated CI (dotnet test, 3 runs per side)
runs.what: Agent's tests (SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerTests) on base 32258fdb and on the branch
runs.detail: Base: 4/8 fail (the three duplicate/mixed key tests on suppressed types, and DuplicateKeysAreReportedWithoutAnalyzerFailureForGeneratedTypes, which shows the crash is not specific to SuppressSourceGeneration), 4/8 pass (missing key, AllowPrivate, non-serializable member type, source-generation-only diagnostics). Branch: 8/8 pass. Stable over 3 runs on each side.

runs.what: Full MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests suite on the branch (regenerates and compares snapshots)

not_checked.what: The exact regression reported in the issue (analyzer silent for suppressed types since 3.1.1)
not_checked.why: not reproduced on base 32258fdb: simple diagnostics are already reported there; only the crash on duplicate/mixed keys was observed. The issue gives no reproduction code.
